messages:
maya: Quick Q — need a one-off SIEM export for vuln triage. Requirements: scrubbed (remove PII), timeboxed TTL (48h), and KMS unwrap only for the job. What's the approved flow? cc @eli @anthony :eyes:
eli: Short answer: use the export-gate workflow. Create a ticket with justification + TTL + consumer list, secops approval required. We do ephemeral CMK unwraps tied to the ticket.
anthony: Also include a field whitelist/blacklist. Our standard: keep event_id,timestamp,service,hashed_user; drop or mask ip/email/full_name.
maya: Can masking happen client-side before export, or does the pipeline need to scrub? Prefer pipeline scrub so analysts never see raw data.
shreya: Pipeline scrub is required for exports that leave the platform or are shared with 3rd parties. For internal vuln triage we can grant ephemeral unmask to specific analysts but it must be logged and have two approvers (secops + oncall lead). There's a template for the scrub config in the ticket comments.
security-bot: Created ticket SEC-4821 for export request by maya. Link: https://jira.redwood/SEC-4821 :pushpin:
eli: We'll need the CMK policy snippet added to the ticket. Example minimal policy (attach to ephemeral unwrap role):
```json
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt", "kms:DescribeKey"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:region:acct:key/ephemeral-unwrap",
  "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"kms:ViaService": "export-gate.redwood"}}
}
```
anthony: CLI example for ops to run once ticket is approved:
```bash
export-cli --range "2026-05-02..2026-05-04" \
  --fields "event_id,timestamp,service,hashed_user" \
  --mask "ip,email" \
  --ttl 48h \
  --unwrap-cmk "ephemeral:secops/unwrap" \
  --attach-ticket SEC-4821
```
maya: Will the KMS unwrap show up in audit logs? We need chain-of-custody for the vuln report.
shreya: Yes — KMS decrypt events are logged in Cloud Audit + we add a record to the SEC ticket with export metadata (who requested, approvers, consumer list, hash of exported artifact). Analyst sessions must be MFA-protected and we enable session recording for the export window.
eli: :thumbsup: I'll add a checklist to SEC-4821: approvals, scrub config, CMK policy, TTL enforcement, artifact hash, and audit links.
maya: Great — i'll attach the prompt set and vuln notes to the ticket and request the two approvers. Ping me if you need anything else.
